description: This Java source file defines the `HttpEngine` class, which extends `GenericAsyncEngine`. It handles both synchronous service execution by making HTTP POST requests with serialized context and deserialization of responses, as well as serving HTTP requests to invoke OFBiz services via servlet requests. The class provides mechanisms for serializing/deserializing service contexts, invoking services asynchronously or synchronously, and responding with serialized results or errors.

classes.name: HttpEngine
classes.description: A class that handles service invocation over HTTP, including serialization/deserialization, and acting as an HTTP servlet endpoint to invoke OFBiz services based on request parameters.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously by serializing the context, making an HTTP call to the service endpoint, then deserializing the result.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Calls runSync and ignores its result.

methods.name: httpEngine
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to invoke services, manages serialization/deserialization, error handling, and response writing.
